# StRyKr Ai

> Applied intelligence firm removing the operational constraints that block growth — broken workflows, preventable revenue loss, and shortages of workforce capacity — with measurable, governed AI systems.

## Company

- Name: StRyKr Ai
- Website: https://www.strykrai.com
- Contact: https://www.strykrai.com (Contact page)
- Sister site: https://www.stemedai.com (STEM education AI)

## What We Do

StRyKr Ai builds measurable systems that address:
- Broken workflows costing hours
- Preventable revenue leakage
- Workforce capacity shortages

Every engagement follows: Discover → Design → Deploy → Measure.
A decision gate at every stage — scale, revise, or stop.

## Service Areas

### 1. AI Automations & Custom Agents
- Intake & re-keying automation
- Classification & routing
- Follow-up & escalation (revenue leakage detection)
- Custom AI agents on approved knowledge only
- Governance: permissions, business rules, review gates, monitoring, rollback
- Aligned to NIST AI Risk Management Framework

### 2. AI for Education (K-12 & Higher Ed)
- AI literacy and safe-use training for teachers, administrators, principals, counselors, IT, and faculty
- AI policy development and rollout
- Role-specific workshops with guardrails
- AI governance readiness assessments
- Department-specific playbooks
- Federal/state grant tracking
- Higher ed: dropout detection, AI advising, workforce readiness

### 3. Workforce & EB-5 Project Readiness
- Healthcare workforce demand forecasting
- Credentialing operating models
- Ethical recruitment standards
- EB-5 project readiness coordination (documentation, disclosure, professional roles)
- Boundary: legal, immigration, securities determinations remain with licensed professionals

### 4. Revenue Intelligence
- Revenue leakage quantification
- Controls design and finance validation

## Principles

1. Business case before build
2. Production over presentation
3. Human authority stays visible
4. Designed for existing operations
5. Evidence before expansion

## Team Structure

- Principal — Applied AI: workflow diagnosis, solution architecture, deployment governance
- Principal — Revenue Intelligence: leakage quantification, controls design, finance validation
- Practice Lead — Workforce: demand forecasting, credentialing operations, employer coordination
- Named collaborators: legal, immigration, securities, or clinical specialists, engaged per scope

## Evidence Standard

Every published outcome includes:
- Baseline: what was happening before intervention
- Scope: the workflow, site, population, or period measured
- Result: the observed change, including unfavorable findings
- Source: the system or institution the measure came from
- Validation: the client owner or independent party that reviewed it
- Limits: what the result does not establish
